project.title: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing of wastewater treatment microbial communities
project.description: This study investigates microbial communities in a representative recirculating aquaculture wastewater treatment system known as the three ponds and two dams (3P-2D) system. Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was conducted to characterize the taxonomic composition and functional potential of wastewater microbial communities. Genomic DNA was extracted from wastewater samples using a commercial water DNA extraction kit according to the manufacturers instructions. DNA quality and concentration were assessed prior to library preparation. Shotgun metagenomic libraries were constructed and sequenced on the Illumina NovaSeq X Plus platform using paired-end 150 bp reads. Raw sequencing reads were subjected to quality assessment and trimming to remove adapter sequences and low quality bases prior to downstream analyses.
